artboards.title: 3 · Job pack (one click on a card)
2 · Shared inbox, emails finding their job

annotations.text:
Read in order 1 → 2 → 3 → 4.
Emails land in the shared inbox and are filed to a job (2). Clicking a card on the board (1) opens the job pack (3): details, emails, engineer's report and photos gathered in one place. Build quote (4) pre-fills Sanctuary's template and exports the .xlsx into the job folder.
Cards drag between the four stages; each stage is a folder in your SharePoint.

Page 2 (pages menu in the toolbar) has how it works, the four routes compared, and the written proposal.
Only the Cathedral Drive job (SANC004958) is real, taken from your spreadsheet. Every other job, name, address and number is a made-up example to show the layout.

Board shows a drag in progress: SANC005044 lifting out of 'check & amend' and gliding into 'ready to send', with the drop zone lit. In the real thing this is a spring animation and the job folder moves with it.

Left: the picture and the four routes. Right: the written proposal (exports as a paginated PDF from the toolbar).
Recommendation in one line: do the filing and board inside Microsoft 365 first (route A, no code), then build the sleek app on top (route B) with AI running in the browser, so nothing ever leaves your PC or your tenant.
